Create, list and select chart themes

Source: R/theme.R
hc_theme.Rd

A theme contains Highcharts options shared by one or more charts. Start from a packaged preset or supply your own named Highcharts options.

Usage

hc_theme(preset = NULL, ...)

hc_themes()

hc_set_theme(theme, ...)

Arguments

preset

A name returned by hc_themes(), or NULL to start from an empty theme.

...

Named Highcharts options. Nested options override individual fields. Arrays such as colors and gradient stops are replaced in full. In a fontFamily field, name a bundled or page-supplied family, or pass sass::font_google() to include a web font with the chart.

theme

A preset name or an object created with hc_theme().

Value

hc_theme() returns an hc_theme object. hc_themes() lists the available preset names. hc_set_theme() sets highcharter.theme for subsequent charts in the R process and invisibly returns the previous option.

See also

hc_add_theme(), hc_theme_merge(), vignette("themes", package = "highcharter")

Examples

hc_themes()
#>  [1] "538"          "alone"        "bloom"        "bslib"        "carbon"      
#>  [6] "chalk"        "cloudscape"   "darkunica"    "db"           "economist"   
#> [11] "elementary"   "ffx"          "flat"         "flatdark"     "ft"          
#> [16] "ggplot2"      "google"       "gridlight"    "handdrawn"    "hcrt"        
#> [21] "monokai"      "null"         "sandsignika"  "smpl"         "sparkline"   
#> [26] "sparkline_vb" "superheroes"  "tufte"       
highchart(theme = hc_theme("ft")) |> hc_add_series(data = c(3, 1, 4))


team <- hc_theme("carbon", colors = c("#005F73", "#CA6702"))
hc_theme(chart = list(style = list(fontFamily = "IBM Plex Sans")))
#> $chart
#> $chart$style
#> $chart$style$fontFamily
#> [1] "IBM Plex Sans"
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "hc_theme"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
hc_theme(chart = list(style = list(fontFamily = sass::font_google("Noto Sans"))))
} # }
old <- hc_set_theme(team)
highchart() |> hc_add_series(data = c(3, 1, 4))


options(old)
